data.title: 黑歌 · 竹林月影下的改良旗袍回眸
data.description: 月光穿透修竹林海，黑歌身着高开叉墨色改良旗袍独立于石板小径，猫耳微动，金眸含笑回首。
data.action: 高开叉改良旗袍轻拂修长双腿，单手扶竹侧身回首，猫尾优雅弯曲
data.lighting: 清冷皎洁月光穿透竹叶，形成斑驳银白光影
data.camera: 中景侧后身四分之三机位，景深虚化幽静竹林
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, kuroka, nekomata, black cat ears, twin tails, two black cat tails, golden eyes, black sleeveless modern cheongsam, high slit dress, gold floral embroidery, standing on stone path in moonlit bamboo grove, looking back over shoulder with sultry smile, silver moonlight through bamboo leaves, ethereal atmospheric night.
data.animaCaption: 1girl, solo, kuroka, cat ears, two tails, golden eyes, black cheongsam with high slit, looking back in moonlit bamboo forest.
